scripts.infra:up: docker compose -f docker/compose.dev.yml up -d 2>nul || wsl docker compose -f docker/compose.dev.yml up -d 2>nul || echo WARNING: Docker not found. Start Postgres, Redis, and MinIO manually.
scripts.infra:down: docker compose -f docker/compose.dev.yml down 2>nul || wsl docker compose -f docker/compose.dev.yml down 2>nul || echo Docker not found. Stop services manually.
scripts.infra:logs: docker compose -f docker/compose.dev.yml logs -f 2>nul || wsl docker compose -f docker/compose.dev.yml logs -f
